chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari. He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, God — blessed be He and exalted — chose me, selected me, and made me a messenger. He revealed the Master of Books to me. So I said: 'My God and my Master, indeed You sent Musa to Pharaoh, and he asked You to make his brother Harun a vizier to reinforce him and give credibility to his words. And indeed I ask You, O my Master and my God, to make for me a vizier from my family to reinforce me.' So God made Ali my vizier and my brother, and He placed courage in his heart, and He dressed him in awe over his enemy. He was the first to believe in me and affirm me, and the first to affirm the oneness of God with me. And indeed I asked my Lord, Mighty and Majestic, for that and He granted it to me.

So he is the Master of the Successors. Adherence to him is happiness, and death in obedience to him is martyrdom. His name in the Torah is joined to my name. His wife is the greatest truthful one, my daughter. His two sons are the Masters of the Youth of Paradise, and they are my sons. He, his sons, and the Imams after them are the Proofs of God over His creation after the prophets. They are the gates of knowledge in my nation. Whoever follows them will be saved from the Fire, and whoever follows their example will be guided to the Straight Path. God, Mighty and Majestic, does not bestow love for them upon a servant except that He will bring him to Paradise.

key_terms.الأوصياء: The successors/deputies (al-awsiya) - religious deputies appointed by divine authority to continue prophetic guidance
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقَة الكُبرَى: The greatest truthful one (al-siddiqah al-kubra) - title of Lady Fatimah
key_terms.حُجَج: Proofs/arguments (hujaj) - divine proofs over creation, referring to the Imams’ authoritative role
key_terms.وَزِير: Vizier/helper (wazir) - a divinely appointed supporter who reinforces the prophet’s mission

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali’s status compared to Harun and the role of the Imams?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through a chain going back to Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) recounts his supplication to God, drawing a parallel between his request for a helper and the earlier request of Prophet Musa for his brother Harun. God granted the Prophet Ali as his vizier and brother, the first believer, and the Master of Successors. The hadith extends Ali’s status to his wife Fatimah (the greatest truthful one), his sons Hasan and Husayn (Masters of the Youth of Paradise), and the succeeding Imams, declaring them all as God’s proofs over creation, gates of knowledge, and guarantors of salvation and guidance.
word_analysis: and He granted it to me.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali (rh) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal from Jabir b. Yazid from Abi’l Zubayr al-Makki from Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari. He said: The Prophet (s) said:

Surely, Allah selected me, chose me, and made me a messenger. He revealed the Master of Books to me. So, I said: “My God and My Master! Surely, you sent Musa to Pharaoh, and he asked You if You could make his brother Harun a vizier to reinforce him and give further credibility to his words. O My Master and My God! I ask you to make for me a vizier from my family to reinforce me.” So, Allah made `Ali my vizier and my brother, and He emboldened his heart, and He dressed him in prestige over his enemies. He was the first to believe in me and the first to believe in Allah’s oneness with me. I asked my Lord for that and He granted it to me;

so, he is the Master of Deputies. Following him is happiness and dying in obedience to him is martyrdom. His name in the Torah is attached to my name. His wife is the great saint, my daughter. His sons are the Masters of the Youth of Paradise, and they are my sons. He, his sons, and the Imams after them are the Proofs of Allah over His creation after the prophets. They are the gates of knowledge in my Nation. Whoever follows them will be delivered from the Fire, and whoever believes in them will be guided to the Straight Path. Allah does not cause a worshiper to love them except that He will bring him to Paradise.
